question: Which ace footballer and former Indian football team captain was selected for the Padma Shri honour in 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**IM Vijayan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The legendary Indian footballer **Inovivalappil Mani Vijayan**, popularly known as **IM Vijayan**, has been selected for the prestigious **Padma Shri** award in the year **2025**.
 
• He served as the **former captain** of the **Indian National Football Team** and is celebrated as one of the most gifted strikers to ever represent the country, often referred to as the **"Black Pearl of Indian Football"**.
 
• **IM Vijayan** holds the distinction of being the first player to be honored as the **AIFF Player of the Year** on three separate occasions, specifically in the years **1993, 1997, and 1999**.
